flags.message: Petition page 14 says Judge VanDyke did not opine on the scope of appropriate relief. The provisioned appendix at 25a instead expressly agrees with the majority's propositions permitting plan-wide financial and equitable recovery, before dissenting on contract interpretation and delegation. I relied on the opinion itself and did not count the panel dissent as supporting petitioners on the question presented. This is a characterization discrepancy in party advocacy, not a provisioning failure.
